name: Baked Cloud Density and AO Sampling
aliases: Direct 3D Weather Volume Rendering with Analytical SDF
definition: An optimized cloud density function that samples precomputed baked density and AO from a 3D texture instead of procedurally evaluating noise and density.
summary: Baked Cloud Density and AO Sampling precomputes 3D Worley cell density and SDF into textures, enabling efficient raymarching with space skipping instead of procedural noise evaluation.
